modules.name: tensor
modules.description: Core tensor operations with automatic differentiation. Supports backward-mode AD (reverse mode) via autograd and forward-mode AD via DualTensor. Foundation for all numerical computation in simplex-learning.

modules.name: optim
modules.description: Streaming optimizers for continuous learning. Provides online learning variants of standard optimizers (SGD, Adam, AdamW) that work with streaming data, plus learning rate schedulers.

items.name: Optimizer

items.name: ParamGroup

modules.name: memory
modules.description: Experience replay and forgetting prevention. Provides replay buffers, Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC), Memory Aware Synapses (MAS), and progressive networks to prevent catastrophic forgetting during continuous learning.

modules.name: feedback
modules.description: Feedback signal collection and credit assignment. Provides typed channels for receiving learning signals and attributing them to neural gates using temporal credit (TD-lambda), GAE, attention credit, and counterfactual credit methods.

modules.name: calibration
modules.description: Confidence calibration for neural gates. Ensures confidence outputs reflect true probabilities (a model with 80% confidence should be correct 80% of the time). Provides temperature scaling, Platt scaling, beta calibration, and online calibration.

modules.name: safety
modules.description: Constraints and bounds for safe learning. Ensures learning cannot break program correctness with hard constraints (always enforced) and soft constraints (guide optimization). Includes no-learn zones, no-gradient zones, and invariants.

modules.name: distributed
modules.description: Hive-wide coordinated learning. Provides federated learning (FedAvg, Median, TrimmedMean), knowledge distillation (teacher-student, self-distillation), gradient synchronization, and belief conflict resolution across hives.

modules.name: runtime
modules.description: Learning loop execution, metrics collection, and checkpointing for real-time continuous learning systems.

modules.name: belief
modules.description: Grounded beliefs with full epistemic metadata. Prevents confidently producing coherent nonsense by requiring every belief to be grounded to observations, with provenance tracking, evidence links, falsification conditions, calibrated confidence, and domain-scoped applicability.

modules.name: epistemic
modules.description: Epistemic annealing and self-correction. Implements anti-confirmation annealing where temperature responds to epistemic health rather than just confidence. Includes mandatory dissent windows, counterfactual probing, a skeptic specialist that challenges beliefs, and a meta-optimizer tying all components together.
